name: pagode-remote
description: Standalone Capacitor app: BLE remote for the Pagode (DSD TECH 2-channel BLE relay, SH-HC-08), two channels ON/OFF/pulse. Web UI is the single source HTML/pagode/pagode-remote.html; `npm run prep` copies it into www/ before sync. See ../Solita_goes_Pagode.md.

scripts.cap:add: npm run prep && npx cap add android
scripts.cap:sync: npm run prep && npx cap sync android
